item.title: Symbiotic nitrogen fixation sustains carbon sinks under warming Tibetan permafrost region
item.content:encoded:
Communications Earth & Environment, Published online: 18 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43247-026-04085-8

Aboveground symbiotic nitrogen fixation by legumes provides a critical nitrogen source that supports plant biomass growth and sustains carbon sequestration in warming Tibetan permafrost grasslands, based on nitrogen isotope analyses and ecosystem modeling.
